input: Build a LAMMPS data file in the class II PCFF-INTERFACE force field (INTERFACE FF 1.5) for an MPEG-type PCE: poly(methacrylic acid) backbone, fully deprotonated, with 30 methacrylate units and 10 MPEG methacrylate side chains of 23 ethylene-oxide units (methoxy-terminated), random sequence, hydrogen chain ends, sodium counter-ions. Put the system in a periodic box only slightly larger than the atoms (about 2 Å of empty space on every side).
